news.analysis: Sanders did well in his spot start for the injured Deshaun Watson. He took care of the ball and didn't commit a turnover. He still took five sacks, but overall it wasn't a bad showing. It did take a while for him to get going, as the Browns only had six points going into the fourth quarter. But, he and the offense were able to get back in and give a good try for the win, falling short on a failed two-point conversion. Watson should be back starting next week, but Sanders certainly put him on notice.
